probe: POST /v2/products then GET then DELETE (creates a draft and removes it in the same run)
response_excerpt: Creation is supported but capped right now: "Sorry, you can only create 10 products per day.". A daily cap is only imposed on something the API does. Treat listing as automatable and retry the lifecycle check after the cap resets before building on it.
